description: This file contains a script to validate VLAN configuration on LAN ports using UCI commands on a network device, including setup, verification, and output stabilization methods.

methods.name: Create R alias
methods.description: Defines an alias R for remote command execution or local command substitution.

methods.name: Create/ensure VLAN named vlan10
methods.description: Creates or verifies the VLAN configuration for vlan10 with specified parameters using UCI commands.

methods.name: Confirm UCI has vlan10 with vid 10
methods.description: Checks that the VLAN vlan10 exists with the correct VLAN ID using grep, sed, and sort.

methods.name: Validate the sub-interface appears
methods.description: Verifies that the sub-interface br-lan.10 exists and displays its link details.
